children.name: Laxitextum lutescens
children.description: Basidiomata resupinate to pileate, 0.4 – 0.6 mm thick, pileus deep yellow to pale brown, velutinate, azonate; hymenial surface cream-yellow to straw-coloured with a notably pale purplish brown tint; trama well developed, pale yellowish brown. Hyphal system monomitic; hyphae with clamps; tramal hyphae loosely interwoven, pale yellow, 3 – 5 μm wide; oleiferous hyphae abundant in subhymenium and trama, distinctly amyloid, 4 – 6 μm wide. Gloeocystidia present, 90 – 120 (– 200) × 6 – 9 μm, in the young state fusiform, subulate, often with a moniliform apical appendix, occasionally up to 200 μm long
